name: Erina
source:
Rambunctious and Playful

There’s never a dull moment when Erina’s around.

Her exuberant nature and fondness for jokes can often lead people to write her off as foolish, but beneath her optimistic facade, Erina hides a clever mind and tender heart.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1470378130808487944?s=20&t=cp2Bb5I1qzUClYj_2_plbw]official Twitter[/url]]
